issues: 工作台按 inline 猜成 45f，渲染在俯冲半途截断，气垫减速和落定根本没出现
页面悬在纯色平底上，没有地面参照，俯冲时读不出速度与高度
地面软影是一团带明显色环的径向渐变，离页面很远，和页面关系脱节
终点 1.35 倍特写靠 transform 放大位图，文字发糊
俯冲前无预备、落定后无停留，动作一结束就切
changes: 补导出 DRONE_DIVE_LANDING_DURATION=105：24f 建立 + 25f 俯冲 + 20f 气垫 + 36f（1.2s）落定呼吸
页面与 48px 点阵地面同处一个 3D 世界：俯冲时点阵向镜头涌来、拉出速度线，落地后点阵淡到 55%
地面接触影改为页面同形的模糊矩形，随悬停高度 150→0 收紧变实；背景换 Backdrop 柔光底并移出动态模糊（消除多重采样色环）
页面按 1.35 倍 CSS zoom 布局再 scale(1/1.35) 缩回，终点特写文字锐利（Q2）
俯冲前 20f 相机上提 2.5% 行程作预备；落定后 hero 卡外圈轻压暗收焦；CameraMotionBlur 采样 9→12 减少文字分层
issuesEn: The workbench guessed 45f from inline code, so the render cut off mid-dive and the cushion and landing never showed
The page floated over a flat backdrop with no ground reference, so neither speed nor altitude read
The ground shadow was a banded radial blob far below the page, visually disconnected from it
The 1.35x close-up came from transform-scaling a bitmap, so text went soft
No anticipation before the dive and no hold after landing
changesEn: Exported DRONE_DIVE_LANDING_DURATION=105: 24f establish + 25f dive + 20f cushion + 36f (1.2s) settle
Page and a 48px dot-grid floor share one 3D world: dots rush toward camera during the dive as speed cues, then fade to 55% on landing
Contact shadow is now a blurred page-shaped rect that tightens as hover height goes 150→0; backdrop is a soft-light Backdrop rendered outside the motion blur (no sampling bands)
Page laid out at 1.35x CSS zoom then scaled down by 1/1.35, so the final close-up text is crisp (Q2)
2.5% pull-up anticipation over 20f before the dive; a gentle focus vignette around the hero card after landing; CameraMotionBlur samples 9→12 to reduce text stepping
